description: The bar chart illustrates and compares scores across three different quality score categories using two distinct metrics, alongside two baseline reference values. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Quality Scores," which are ordered from left to right as "IFD," a middle category with its text obscured by a solid gray rectangle, and "DEITA." The vertical axis represents the values, labeled "Scores," featuring a linear scale that ranges from 30 to 70 with tick marks at regular intervals of 5 units. The chart displays grouped vertical bars, with each category containing two adjacent bars. According to the legend, the light blue bars represent "$Avg_{obj}$" and the light orange bars represent "$Avg_{sub}$." Additionally, the legend identifies a blue dashed horizontal line as "Base $Avg_{obj}$" and an orange dashed horizontal line as "Base $Avg_{sub}$." Each bar is annotated with its exact numerical value placed directly above it. For the "IFD" category, the light blue bar has a value of 63.98, and the light orange bar has a value of 41.90. In the middle obscured category, the light blue bar is 66.06, and the light orange bar is the shortest of its color at 39.13. For the "DEITA" category, the light blue bar is the tallest overall at 67.64, while the light orange bar is the tallest of its color at 42.99. The blue dashed line spans the width of the chart at a value of 64.71, which is annotated on the far right above the line. The orange dashed line similarly spans the chart at a value of 37.91, also annotated on the right. The bars are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending order, and visual emphasis is provided by the exact value annotations, the horizontal reference lines, and the gray redaction block on the horizontal axis.
